metadata.case_name: LAM HING CHOI v. YIP KING ON AND OTHERS

plaintiff.occupation_before: material handler working in construction sites

source: However, Mr Lam developed a post-traumatic frozen shoulder.
Dr Au ... the shoulder joint painful condition was probably produced by scar adhesion.

I accept that lifting and transporting heavy building materials would be too much for him. He has persistent pain and restrictions of movement in the right shoulder and he being right-handed, could not handle material on his shoulder for the purpose of lifting up and carrying the same from one place to another.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of other specified muscle, fascia, tendon or bursa at shoulder or upper arm level

source: he was hit by an opening partition of a lorry against his right upper arm. His right index finger was also injured.
The injury to the plaintiff’s right arm and the index finger were all healed.
injuries.icd_description: Injuries to the wrist or hand, unspecified

manifestations.description: persistent pain and restrictions of movement in the right shoulder
restrictions of movement in the right shoulder
certain degree of wasting of muscle around the right shoulder

treatments_received: clinical examinations by Dr Au and Dr Lau

losses.description: persistent pain and restrictions of movement in the right shoulder; certain degree of wasting of muscle around the right shoulder
could not go back to his previous job as a material handler involving heavy labour work in construction sites; suitable job would be a security guard (more sedentary)

comparable_cases.case_name: Lee Lap Pang v. Yuen Tat Wah trading as Chong Hing Motor Company
comparable_cases.injury_description: the plaintiff fell from 10 feet and suffered right shoulder pain due to bicept and rotator cuff tendenitis, and right elbow pain due probably to ulnar neuritis. The same Dr Lau assessed him to have suffered 14% permanent disability.
